cases.sentence: Это был первый год правления Навуходоносора, царя ___.
cases.translation: This was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
cases.explain: The possessive construction царь Вавилона (king of Babylon) requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мне открывалось слово Господне, и я говорил вам снова и снова, но вы не ___.
cases.translation: The word of Yahweh came to me and I spoke to you repeatedly, but you did not listen.
cases.explain: The past tense matches the description of repeated action over decades.

cases.sentence: Живите на земле, которую Господь отдал вам и вашим отцам ___.
cases.translation: Dwell in the land that Yahweh gave to your fathers forever.
cases.explain: The adverbial form навеки (forever) is used with the verb дал (gave).

cases.sentence: Не вызывайте мой гнев делами ваших ___.
cases.translation: Don't provoke my anger with the work of your hands.
cases.explain: The construction делами ваших рук (works of your hands) uses genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я нашлю войска на эту страну и всех ее ___.
cases.translation: I will bring armies against this land and all its inhabitants.
cases.explain: The verb нашлю (I will send against) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю их и станут они ___ навеки.
cases.translation: I will make them and they will become desolations forever.
cases.explain: The verb станут (will become) requires the instrumental case.

cases.translation: These nations will serve the king of Babylon.
cases.explain: The possessive construction царь Вавилона requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Напои из нее все народы, которым я тебя ___.
cases.translation: Make all nations drink it, to whom I send you.
cases.explain: The present tense describes Jeremiah's ongoing mission.

reading.ru: Двадцать три года, начиная с тринадцатого года правления иудейского царя Иосии, и до сегодняшнего дня, мне открывалось слово Господне, и я говорил вам снова и снова, но вы не слушали.
reading.question: For how long has Jeremiah been delivering God's message?
options: For twenty-three years Jeremiah has spoken repeatedly, but the people have not listened
reading.correct: For twenty-three years Jeremiah has spoken repeatedly, but the people have not listened
reading.explain: The text states: 'These twenty-three years, Yahweh's word has come to me...but you have not listened.'

reading.ru: Господь посылал к вам всех своих слуг-пророков снова и снова, но вы не слушали их и даже не обращали внимания.
reading.question: What efforts did God make to reach the people before judgment?
options: He sent all His prophets repeatedly, but they did not listen
reading.correct: He sent all His prophets repeatedly, but they did not listen
reading.explain: The text says: 'Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets...but you have not listened.'

reading.ru: За то, что вы не слушали моих слов, я призову все северные народы и моего слугу, Навуходоносора, царя Вавилона, и нашлю их на эту страну и всех ее обитателей.
reading.question: What is God's judgment for disobedience?
options: He will send northern peoples and Nebuchadnezzar against the land
reading.correct: He will send northern peoples and Nebuchadnezzar against the land
reading.explain: God says: 'I will send and take all the families of the north...and will bring them against this land.'

reading.ru: Вся страна будет опустошена и страшна, а эти народы будут семьдесят лет служить царю Вавилона.
reading.question: What is the duration of exile?
options: The nations will serve Babylon for seventy years
reading.correct: The nations will serve Babylon for seventy years
reading.explain: The text states: 'This whole land will be a desolation...these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.'

reading.ru: Но по прошествии семидесяти лет я накажу царя Вавилона и его народ, страну халдеев, за их вину, и приведу ее в вечное запустение.
reading.question: What does God promise after seventy years?
options: He will punish Babylon and make it an eternal desolation
reading.correct: He will punish Babylon and make it an eternal desolation
reading.explain: The text says: 'When seventy years are accomplished, I will punish the king of Babylon...I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.'

reading.ru: Так сказал мне Господь Бог Израиля. «Прими из моей руки эту чашу, наполненную вином моей ярости, и напои из нее все народы, которым я тебя посылаю.»
reading.question: What symbolic action does God command?
options: Take a cup filled with wine of wrath and make all nations drink from it
reading.correct: Take a cup filled with wine of wrath and make all nations drink from it
reading.explain: God tells Jeremiah: 'Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to drink it.'
